testo:
■ G-Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your creatures. (If a creature is under it, treat it as a Neo Evolution Creature, and when it would leave, all cards under it leave instead.)
■ You may put evolution creatures on your creatures as if they had every civilization.
